Daniel further states that the deleted exact private Sunday minute and curb should not come back through hints or follow-up logic. More broadly, Daniel states that nothing deleted in the household coordination chain should be restated later under pressure; Elise Holt has recorded this as a standing instruction applying to the whole Rowan cluster.
